notes.title: Turn Based Combat Updated
notes.content:
This New Version 6.5.2.6 Contains:

Big Updates:
*You can now name the battlers you encounter the first time:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31303718/0984b1a49604666497de9cfc093ef9f48f715e0e.png[/img]

*Added new icons for the items of the game:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31303718/da8f14863ba16ffd2d3b9cba2dec67fb4ad23684.png[/img]

*Added New HP HUDs to battlers during the turn based combat:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31303718/0c5bc6f8229740ec6546a571f8cc1faaa6c013c4.png[/img]

*A fancy visual upgrade to the Items Drop after a Battle:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31303718/f1136c53895360fcdbc9b34fb58417851a2832ac.png[/img]

[i]And More:[/i]

Standard Update:
*Two New window types. Those changes the frame style of the interfaces. You can select it from the graphics option menu.
*New icons for various the stats effects.

Small upgrades:
*Added an animation for the tech gears obtained after a battle.
*Added the remove state items to the E-bit, HP and Hyper Jump Merchants.
*The Pop Up Numbers during a battle have been Retouched.
*Two retouches to the animation of the power charge items.
*Added a cinematic effect when a conversation triggers during a battle.
*Add a healing skill to the Model Y9 and an Energy Implosion to Model Z1
*Extra frames duration for the phase fields animation.
*Renamed some terms and polish to the main interface cursors.

Corrections:
*Removed the battle log text of the turn based combat mechanic. It was Redundant.
*Generally adjusted the Battle Speed Mechanic.
*A secret spot on the stage 7 main zone has been shown if touched.


Fixes:
*The cursor stays in the selected position after a failed phase shield activation due lack of resources.
*More delay frames to reactivate the cursor selection of the save option in the main interface.
*There were times in which the animation of the Phase fields was gone, it is now fixed.

Thank you for Playing!

notes.title: New Standard Update
notes.content:
This version 6.3.7.7 contains:

Featured:
*Two new HUDs indicators for the Fuel and Shields, on the Main Menu of the game.
*Now, if all golden medals of a Stage were collected. In the respective section of the Fractal Exploration System, a golden frame will appear for such stage.

Standard:
*New Type of Green shields that respawn, those can be found on one of the last stages of the game.
*A better visual for a terrain layer in one of the last stages of the game.
*Some optimization for the Arcader 3000.
*The Tachyon Field effect with battlers on the map is now faster and dynamic.
*Added a new animation for the objects that require bronze gears on one of the last stages of the game. It indicates the amount instead of just a text message all the time.

Small upgrades:
*A little polish to an animation skill: the "Destructive Wave" one used by space probes.
*Added the "stored item" animation to the Fuel item, for when the Vault is active.
*The Golden Medal obtained that appears after finishing an area or zone, has now a Golden Gear Icon to represent more clearly its function.
*More pitch variations for when the laser chargers are taken.
*For the biggest map with ice asteroids, there was added a visual clue when a laser charge is collected after being taken.

Corrections:
*Adjusted the lower amount of golden gears that the Portals remove in the artificial spaces, to give more margin in easier difficulties.
*The Vault didn't have its animation when player was on the Bonus Areas, now it has.
*The Ultra and Omega Speed time were consumed too fast during the use of the Arcader 3000, now their time does not consume at all.
*The Ice Asteroids impact sounds had been adjusted to feel smoother.
*Added a transparency to the "You are Here" effect when respawning on the map.
*Polish to the Main Zone of Stage 10:
 -The especial case of the animation trigger when the menu is used, is now way faster.
 -Taking the Restoration Points is faster and they temporarily banish.
*The message of Game Over, indicating that the Golden Gears are gone, is better aligned to the center.

*The impact from puzzle objects that are asteroids (The Ice Asteroids and the ones like brown boulders), does not affect the Items collected since in most of these cases the collision cannot be avoided.

*On the new effects for the puzzle platforms of the Stage 21, there was an unnecessary spin when solving it correctly. It has been removed to save up time.

Fixes:
*There was a softblock of the game that happened to certain groups of battlers in the Area 3 of Stage 25. It has been fixed now.
*Fixed a glitch that prevented the player from moving when launching the Hyper jump from the Main Menu interface.
*Fixed the mistake of the Menu availability on a special bonus map that shouldn't have it.
*Fixed a glitch with the shield item that goes into the inventory didn't add the shield properly.
*The weather effects of stage 10 now go away properly if the Hyper Jump is launched from the map.
*There were two spots in which the tile layer didn't have the latest teleport indicator texture. It is fixed now.
*There was a glitch with the display of some medals indicators in the Fractal Exploration System, it has now been fixed.

Thanks so much for your support!

notes.title: New Set of Quality Updates
notes.content:
This new version 6.3.1.3 contains the following:

Featured updates:
*The Tachyon Field has been upgraded, it will block the direct battles around the map. 
*A better performance with more details for the main zone of stage 10 (like weather effects.)
*A new short animation for when a phase field is gone with more dynamic timing for when it's active.
*Activating Phase fields is more responsive now and tell you the remaining time of the Phase field.
*The Omega Speed token has a better visual performance.
*The exchangers are now more reliable than before.
*Polished the fractal exploration system.
*Added two music track variations for the main zone of stage 15.
*indicator of Map Teleport spots on Stage 15 onwards
*The Hp exiting portal of the artificial zones is faster.
*Added a visual effect for the puzzle of the main zone of stage 18.
*in stage 20, the last start teleports to the last segment of the zone.
*The puzzle elements of the stage 22 now become transparent when used by the player. It gives a clearer visual indicator of which ones have been interacted with.
*A more reliable main menu with smoother performance.
*Changed the text message of the speed returning to normal. Now, it is an animation instead of words.
*The Audio Signals animation had been retouched and that "special activation" now works if the player has green shields.
*Added more cache to the images for the main menu in the last stage.

Fixes and Corrections:
*Added an evader to a blocked path on the area 4 of the stage 7. It will allow the option to respawn to escape the position.
*There was a problematic activation with the battlers of stage 16 that messed up the menu interface after colliding with the player at the same time. It has now been fixed.
*There were two respawn points too close to two npcs on the area 4 of the stage 19.
*Fixed a block that obstructed the player unnecessary, on one of the last maps.
*Fixed the extra sounds when more than 1 Arcader 3000 leave the map at the same time.
*Added a visual clue to the surroundings that have the access to the main interface disabled.
*Fixed a missing picture problem with the fractal exploration data of stages.
*A more reliable adjusting of the player speed.
*Prevented the player from using save points if the engine is going to explode due lack of fuel.
*The exiting portal of the artificial zones that takes Golden Gears removes an amount based on the difficulty level.
*There was a tg coin that interrupted the path an NPC on the Area 2 of the Stage 4.
*The omega tokens in the area 2 of stage 7 interrupted the paths of some npcs, that is now fixed.
*More accurate audio fade adjustments for the lengths of audio signal songs. 
*Fixed the glitch of music not changing when losing a yellow shield due an asteroid puzzle collision.
*A more reliable usage of the Av.Pag and Re.Pag keys activations when navigating on the map.
*The Tech Gear counter had problems when reaching 1k. Now, it displays the max amount that is able to read.
*There was a picture glitch when taking an Omega Token and going to the Menu, that is now fixed.
*The visual Appearance of the exit spot on the stage 26 is now faster.
*After a special probe gave shields to a player, the picture of the shields failed to update. It has been corrected now.
*Small retouches to the main zone of the Stage 18. Like adding more e-bits in some places and so on.
*Fixing a block that was over a wall in the last stage.
*A smoother transition for the final stage of the game if the Weather and sound effects are active.
*Fixed an odd game over glitch with that depends of a time counter. Happened on one of the last stages of the game.
*Fixed an overstayed image when upgrading the level if there were consecutive activations over the interface.
*Fixed a dialogue box that was aligning too much to the left.
*The restore energy didn't work properly when the level was too advanced. It has been fixed now.
*Fixed a glitch that made a space probe impossible to gather, and it gets lost instead of being in the party.
*The start of an Artificial Space is smoother in the transition.
*Corrected the appearance of the Token Reader item over the Stage Presentation cinematic.
*Fixed some battlers on the main zone of the Stage 22 that had their paths not very well aligned.
*Drastically reduced the flash for the versions II, III of all attacks.
*Reduced the time to traverse one of the latest stages of the game.
*The merchants now disappear after being touched if they had closed their store.
*Fixed a glitch on the first map that happened with the menu being disabled for too long.

Thanks for your support!

*Taking the Tech-Gear Token takes less time, and it shows the amount collected with small animations.

notes.content: *Fixed a missing parallax background for battlers in the biggest stage of the game.

*Added some extra icons for certain battle status on the English version of the game.

*Added the lose of fuel animation to the special object of stage 16.

*Less flashing intensity when respawned due a thunder hit.
*Fixed a visual glitch that show only the speed bar without the speed meter, when inside a Bonus Area.
*reduced the flashing intensity of the psychic wave attacks

notes.title: New Items, Music and Maps!
notes.content:
[i]The new version 6.1.2.3 arrives![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31303718/75c0444e2400788229372da9b35df336d3fccfc8.png[/img]

[b]Specially big updates:[/b]
*25 new musical themes; 20 for the autostarship battlers across the stages and 5 for the artificial spaces. They have been added to the Soundtrack DLC too.
*Upgraded the artificial space zones, each theme features a custom mini puzzle map with new textures. There are more than 75 new mini maps with their respective variations!

[b]Big updates:[/b]
*New Item added: Omega-Token Reader. It tracks of the amount of Omega Speed Tokens in a given map.
*New Item added: The Vault. It stores items in the inventory instead of lost them when maxed out; like with the fuel cells and the shields.
*Added a Speed Gauge for the Ultra Speed feature, it tells you how much time you have left to collect the omega tokens.
*Upgraded the shields feature of the game.

[b]Standard Updates:[/b]
*Upgraded a battle backgrounds of the bonus areas and added it to the Wallpapers DLC.
*Added a special environment effect to the main zone of stage 10.
*New sprite animations for golden gears obtained and lost.
*The flashing of the collisions and transitions are more tenue in nature.
*A better approach to the pitch variation of the tracks, for the map areas.
*Added the "you are here" effect to teleports inside the same map.
*Updated the picture of the log registry catalog.

*Added more effects for when taking items on the map.
*Now, the repeated animation of the ultra and omega speed dims after some seconds.

*Added a better exit to hyper jump if launched on the main zone of stage 28.
*Changed the position of the audio signal displayed picture, is now on the top right of the screen; also it fades out if player goes under it.
*Added a small visual clue for the first paths on stage 10 main zone.
*When the starship runs out of fuel, it can now exit the artificial space normally.
*The ultra and omega speed don't waste time if being on the main menu or during the areas transition.
*Now, taking a fuel cell or shield doesn't restart the musical theme unless necessary.
*Better balance of the difficulty initial values.
*The OmegaSpeed Tokens increase the ultra speed duration when taken.
*Turning a dead end into a connected path in the Area 4 of the Stage 7.
*The msg of unable interface due no fuel left, is now displayed only once. Also, is smoother.
*Some polish to the first tutorial map of the game.
*polished the reaction to stay fixed after a collision, for one of the obstacles types in the stage 22.
*On the stage 2 and 21. Added a shield indicator for the npcs that send the player to an artificial space.
*Added a new animation for the starship sprite when collides with a block type object.
*Faster ending and start presentation of areas and main zones.
*Better music transition for the artificial spaces.
*A smoother activation of the Hyper Jump from the Main Interface.
*Retouches to the golden medal obtained picture.
*Added a message for the first puzzle blocks indicating how many of needed to be found.
*Some small retouches to transitions for stage 10 main zone.
*Added a shortcut for the main zone of stage 17.

*Fixed a stuck comet that looked odd in the main zone of stage 12.
*Fixed the area status keyword not showing up on the after results screen.
*Added a missed translation in the spanish-latam version.
*Fixed an overstayed meter picture when the last part of the animation "map finished" happened.
*Fixed a bug that prevented the main menu from interrupting the message of the ultra speed ending.

*Corrected the rarity version for two of the combatants that need it.
*Fixed the secondary fuel bar appearance on the screen, on the Hyper Jump Dimension.
*The hidden point touch trigger is faster when taking.
*The invisible and hidden TG-tokens are a bit faster to take.
*The respaw point item has less repeated text.
*Small correction for a few UltraSpeed minigame tokens.
*fixed a glitch with the exchanger that gives green shields.

[i]Thanks for your support!
Happy holidays![/i]

notes.title: New Big Quality Updates!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31303718/396aa8c6e06f3841bbf2bfe70a4cc35535e77b1a.png[/img]

Big updates:
*Smoother on screen animations.
*Added more variations to the borders of maps for a better look.
°Added a new fun collectable that gives 1+ tech-gear.

°Better effects of the defeat states in combat.
°Polished the evader zone minigame.

°The message of the Mainframe DECA used to repeat constantly when entering an artificial space, that is now fixed.

notes.title: New Version 2.4.0.0
notes.content:
A new big update for the game has been released:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31303718/faa902a348bb211f24145f1edc28914afb166f8e.png[/img]

* The game now has a better end game with the Final Result screen (at the end of the game), you will be able to see how good you are, taking into account the number of Hyper Speed and Golden Medals obtained, the maximum fight level of the starship and steps taken. 

As always, the best form to get a higher score is to collect golden gears, with the Final Result Screen you can earn up to 20 more if you get everything on five stars.

* There has been added, a new visual on screen, a time counter, it will display how much time you are spending on each Area or Zone. It is a nice way to keep track of your speed results. 

* There has been added more cursor animations to the Main Menu.

* This includes a total of 42 corrections in the game, and more than 65 miscellaneous graphical resources, mostly added by the final result screen.

notes.title: April Update 2018
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31303718/75ee1bb8ba4c089a6926e78af2dac689c739f35e.png[/img]

There has been added upgrades focused mostly on animations:

When you obtain full power points from an exchanger a message is displayed.
The battles ending has now a slow animation of desfragmentation.
All the items like fuel and hyper jump charge now are displaying different animations after they are taken.
There are some new item charts and animations, like the time item.
The main screen has a new vista.
The animated environment is activated from the start, you can disable it anytime in the menu, visual options.
The first level area of the game, that works as a tutorial, gives you fuel items and unlimited shields when you are at critical levels. You still have to search and take them.

The current version is 2.1.9.7
